'''Péter Szalay''' (born June 17, 1962, in [[Szentes]]) is a [[Széchenyi Prize]]-winning Hungarian chemist, member of the [[International Academy of Quantum Molecular Science]] and the [[European Academy of Sciences and Arts]] and professor at the [[Eötvös Loránd University]].

== Education ==
Szalay graduated from the Zrínyi Miklós High School in [[Zalaegerszeg]] in 1980. He received his degree in chemistry from the [[Eötvös Loránd University|Eötvös Loránd University of Sciences]] in 1986. Between 1986 and 1989 he was a doctoral fellow at the Institute of Theoretical Chemistry at the University of Vienna. His supervisor was Professor [[Hans Lischka]]. He received his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] in 1989.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Szalay Péter - ODT Személyi adatlap |url=https://doktori.hu/index.php?menuid=192&lang=HU&sz_ID=2335 |access-date=2024-08-21 |website=doktori.hu}}</ref>

== Academic career ==
Szalay has held various positions at the Department of Chemistry of [[Eötvös Loránd University]] since 1986.<ref>{{Cite web |title=ELTE professor is new member of the European Academy of Sciences and Arts |url=https://www.elte.hu/en/content/elte-professor-is-new-member-of-the-european-academy-of-sciences-and-arts.t.1338 |access-date=2024-08-21 |website=www.elte.hu |language=en}}</ref> He is a full professor since 2004 and was director of the Institute of Chemistry between 2005 and 2008.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Academy of Europe: Szalay Péter |url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Szalay_P%C3%A9ter |access-date=2024-08-21 |website=www.ae-info.org}}</ref>

Between 1991 and 2011, he was a researcher at the [[University of Florida]], the [[University of Mainz]], the [[University of Texas at Austin]] and the [[University of Reims Champagne-Ardenne|University of Reims]].<ref name=":1" />

His research focuses on [[quantum chemistry]], in particular on theoretical methods for the study of electron structure, molecular spectroscopy and potential surfaces. He has published more than 120 scientific articles and co-authored several books.<ref name=":0" />

== Memberships ==
Szalay was vice president of the "Computational Chemistry Division" of the European Chemical Society from 2011 to 2016 and is the president of the Computational and Theoretical Chemistry Division since 2017.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |title=Szalay Péter a legrangosabb kvantumkémiai szervezetben |url=https://www.elte.hu/content/szalay-peter-a-legrangosabb-kvantumkemiai-szervezetben.t.19268 |access-date=2024-08-21 |website=www.elte.hu |language=hu}}</ref>

He is member of the [[International Academy of Quantum Molecular Science]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=Az European Academy of Sciences and Arts tagja lett Szalay Péter |url=https://ttk.elte.hu/content/az-european-academy-of-sciences-and-arts-tagja-lett-szalay-peter.t.3021 |access-date=2024-08-21 |website=ttk.elte.hu |language=hu}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=International Academy of Quantum Molecular Science |url=https://www.iaqms.org/members.php |access-date=2024-09-18 |website=www.iaqms.org}}</ref> the [[Hungarian Academy of Sciences]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=ÁTTEKINTÉS AZ MTA KÉMIAI TUDOMÁNYOK OSZTÁLYA FŐBB TEVÉKENYSÉGEIRŐL |url=https://mta.hu/data/dokumentumok/vii_osztaly/2023/mta_kemia_beszamolo_hosszu.pd |access-date=2024-08-21 |website=MTA}}</ref> and the [[European Academy of Sciences and Arts]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Members |url=https://euro-acad.eu/members |access-date=2024-08-21 |website=euro-acad.eu |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Péter G. Szalay |url=https://pgszalay.elte.hu/en/ |access-date=2024-08-21 |website=pgszalay.elte.hu |language=hu}}</ref>

== Awards ==
Szalay won the [[Széchenyi Prize]] in 2017<ref name=":2" /> and the Polányi Mihály Prize in 2015.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Polányi-díjat kapott Szalay Péter |url=https://www.elte.hu/content/polanyi-dijat-kapott-szalay-peter.t.6418 |access-date=2024-08-21 |website=www.elte.hu |language=hu}}</ref> He was awarded the [[Hungarian Order of Merit]] in 2022.<ref>{{Cite web |title=State Awards |url=https://ttk.elte.hu/en/content/state-awards.t.7237 |access-date=2024-08-21 |website=ttk.elte.hu/en |language=hu}}</ref>
